title: fix(app-shell): the command palette, the inbox and the AI entry ask before dropping unsaved edits (objectui#13253)
body:
Fixes #13253
Clause-②: no

## What was broken

After objectui#13231 the console's header, avatar, workspace and sidebar menus ask before dropping a page's unsaved edits. Other shell departures still called a bare `navigate(...)` from a button, which no page's link guard sees, so a page holding edits was left with no question and the edits were lost. The card measured it on a dirty settings page: header Search, "Accounts", Enter.

## What changed

Every site the card lists was read on `origin/main` before it was changed.

- **`CommandPalette`**: one helper, `leaveTo(to)`, closes the palette (`runCommand`, as before) and then calls `confirmUnsavedLeave(() => navigate(to))`. Every navigating item uses it: recently viewed, record hits, objects, dashboards, pages, reports (navigation and the app's report index), the three Studio-scope groups, and Open full search. The palette's app switch (`onAppChange`) goes through `confirmUnsavedLeave` too. Theme commands do not leave and are unchanged.
- **`InboxPopover`**: View approvals, View all notifications, the activity drill and a notification's own link all go through `leaveTo`. An external notification link still opens a new tab and does not ask, since it leaves nothing.
- **`ConsoleLayout`**: the AI entry (the dock's maximize to `/ai` or `/ai/build?package=PKG`) runs inside `confirmUnsavedLeave`. On Cancel the return location is not recorded.
- **`UnifiedSidebar`**: no change. **Not a departure, measured:** it declares an `onAppChange` prop but never reads it (it destructures `activeAppName` only), and it has no `navigate(` call. Its app links are router links, which the seam's link guard already covers. The census pins this (see Tests).
- **`PermissionMatrixEditor`**: registers `useRegisterUnsavedEdits(isDirty, ...)` with `engine.edit.unsavedLeaveConfirm`, the question its hosts already ask. Its own `beforeunload` guard stays.
- **`StudioDesignSurface`**: registers `useRegisterUnsavedEdits(pillarDirty, ...)` with the same question. Its own confirms on the Home button, the package switcher, the rail swaps and `requestSurface` stay.
  - **One forced change beyond registering:** the pillar `Link`'s own `onClick` confirm is removed. Once the page registers, the seam's capture-phase link guard asks before that link leaves. The `Link`'s confirm would then ask a second time after OK, and the existing `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard.test.tsx` counts calls, so it would catch that. The seam skips the same clicks the handler skipped: a modified or non-primary click, and a link to the page already shown.
- `.changeset/13253-leave-seam-rest.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.
- No change to `chrome/unsavedEdits.ts`, no new export, no new language-pack key. Browser Back and Forward stay out of scope.

## Tests

New, at `55df8e72d8` (later commits only add the changeset):

- `chrome/CommandPalette.unsavedEditsLeave-13253.test.tsx` (4). This is the real palette and provider beside a page that registers with `useRegisterUnsavedEdits`. On a dirty page, choosing "Accounts" asks, closes the palette, and Cancel keeps the path and the input value. OK navigates. The palette's app switch asks, and Cancel never calls `onAppChange`. CONTROL: a clean page never asks.
- `layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.unsavedEditsLeave-13253.test.tsx` (4): View approvals, View all notifications and a notification link each ask; Cancel never navigates; OK goes to the same target as before. CONTROL: clean.
- `layout/__tests__/ConsoleLayout.aiEntryAsksUnsaved-13253.test.tsx` (3): both maximize targets ask; Cancel stays and records no return location; OK goes. CONTROL: clean.
- `views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.registersUnsaved-13253.test.tsx` (3). A dirty matrix makes a shell departure (`confirmUnsavedLeave`, the call every header menu makes, as pinned in `AppHeader.unsavedEditsLeave-13231.test.tsx`) ask the hosts' question. Cancel keeps the edit. CONTROLS: a clean matrix, and an unmounted one.
- `chrome/unsavedEditsLeave.census-13253.test.ts` (7). It masks comments with `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` and lists every `navigate(` in the four shell files. Each must sit inside a `confirmUnsavedLeave(` call or carry a listed reason (none today). It applies the same check to the palette's `onAppChange(`. It also pins that `UnifiedSidebar` declares `onAppChange` and never reads it. A CONTROL shows the census catching a bare call and skipping a wrapped or commented one.
- `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard.test.tsx`, extended. It keeps the window URL at the router's, as `BrowserRouter` does, because the seam's link guard reads it. Three cases are added. Dirty OWD rows, which only the surface registers, make a shell departure ask once. A dirty matrix, which both the matrix and the surface register, asks once. A clean pillar never asks. The existing pillar-link cases now pass through the seam's guard and still count one question per click.

Runs, from the repo root under the shared verify lock, `--maxWorkers=1`:

- The six new or edited files: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 31 passed (31)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Every app-shell test file named for a touched file (`CommandPalette.*`, `InboxPopover.*`, `ConsoleLayout.*`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.*`, `StudioDesignSurface.*`, `unsavedEdits*`), plus the 13231 suites `AppHeader.unsavedEditsLeave`, `SidebarItemMenu.designAsksUnsaved` and `ResourceEditPage.leaveGuard`: 147 files in four batches. Results: 52/52 files (318 tests), 48/48 (263), 24/24 (184) and 23/23 (209). Each batch printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell` directory and the console's `SettingsView.leaveGuard-13163` and `SettingsView.shellLeave-13231` suites (the seam itself is unchanged).

**Ablation**, run after the fix was committed, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restoring from `HEAD`. The palette's `leaveTo` was unwrapped to `runCommand(() => navigate(to))`. On disk, wrapped went from 1 to 0 hits and bare from 0 to 1. The matrix's `useRegisterUnsavedEdits(isDirty, ...)` was deleted (1 to 0 hits). The prediction, written first: two palette cases, the palette census case and the dirty-matrix case go red, and the rest stay green. The Studio cases stay green because the surface still registers. Result: `Tests 4 failed | 20 passed (24)`, exactly those four. Restore was proved by blob hash: `CommandPalette.tsx` `a4c786b48d4b` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` `e0d37267454c` both equal `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is 0 lines.

The warnings are existing ones plus `no-explicit-any` in harness mocks copied from sibling suites. The narrowing is complete: the eslint config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change any verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs now stale, outside this claim's file surface.** `packages/app-shell/README.md` (the "Unsaved edits" section) and `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md` ("6. Unsaved Edits") both still say departures not yet routed through `confirmUnsavedLeave` include "picking a page in the command palette". That sentence is false after this PR. The fix is to drop that clause and list the palette, the inbox and the AI entry among the departures that go through the seam. This is reported to the seat and not edited here.
- **`UnifiedSidebar`'s `onAppChange` prop is declared and never read** (`ConsoleLayout` passes it). It is dead code, so nothing was filed. Carrier: none.
- **A corner of the Studio pillar link, read from source and not measured in a browser:** the old handler skipped any click on the open pillar. The seam skips a link to the page already shown, by pathname. These differ only if Studio is ever shown at a URL without its pillar segment. Its route is `/studio/:packageId/:tab`, so today they agree.
- Browser Back and Forward stay out of reach, as for objectui#13163 and objectui#13231.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
